items.source: Implementations must be registered via the SpringFactoriesLoader mechanism.
items.translation: 实现必须通过 SpringFactoriesLoader 机制进行注册。

items.source:
Implementations of this method must not throw any exceptions. Consequently,
any exception thrown by an implementation of this method will be ignored, though
potentially logged.
items.translation: 此方法的实现不得抛出任何异常。因此，此方法实现的任何抛出的异常都将被忽略（尽管可能会记录日志）。

items.source: Invoked when a failure was encountered while attempting to load an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 在尝试加载 ApplicationContext 时遇到失败时调用。

items.source: context - the application context that did not load successfully
items.translation: context - 未能成功加载的应用程序上下文

items.source: exception - the exception thrown while loading the application context
items.translation: exception - 加载应用程序上下文时抛出的异常
